outline:
本應用性課程之目標在於介紹AR（Augmented Reality，擴增實境）以及VR（Virtual Reality，虛擬實境）相關知識概論，進一步探討AR/VR相關技術於現今智慧製造與服務業之應用，並展示AR/VR於不同工作環境設計之應用實例，如AR/VR軟硬體操作及體驗、專題製作、各式系統介紹等等。
This is an introductory course of augmented AR/VR and its applications. The course is designed to provide the followings topics: 1.Overview about AR/VR technology applied in smart manufacturing and service industries; 2. Various applications and examples of AR/VR, e.g. software and hardware design and operation, commonly-applied systems, in-class exercises and team projects, etc.
schedule:
Block 1 - AR(擴增實境)與VR(虛擬實境)技術概論
Block 2 - AR/VR相關應用實例
Block 3 - 各式系統介紹
Block 4 - 實作/體驗
scorePolicy: 課堂表現：上課參與狀況、出席率、作業及心得報告等，視情況調整
